verdict.rationale: npm is a hosted registry and account service, so an AI-training opt-out or data-use policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documented control or policy about AI training. Adjacent features such as `"private": true` (blocks publishing), paid private packages, and running a self-hosted registry are related privacy or workaround measures, not an AI-training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
